definitions.explanation: The act of adding new space or rooms to an existing building, or the added section itself.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}が{増|ふ}えたので{部屋|へや}を{増築|ぞうちく}した。
examples.english: We added an extension because our family grew.

examples.japanese: {二階|にかい}を{増築|ぞうちく}する{計画|けいかく}がある。
examples.english: There are plans to add a second floor.

examples.japanese: {増築|ぞうちく}{工事|こうじ}には{許可|きょか}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: A permit is required for extension construction.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{増|ぞう} (increase, add) + {築|ちく} (construction, building)

VERB FORM:
・{増築|ぞうちく}する (to extend, add to a building)

RELATED CONSTRUCTION TERMS:
・{新築|しんちく} (new construction)
・{改築|かいちく} (renovation, structural alteration)
・{修繕|しゅうぜん} (repair)
・{建|た}て{増|ま}し (building addition - more casual)
・リフォーム (remodeling - loanword)

PERMIT REQUIREMENTS:
In Japan, {増築|ぞうちく} often requires:
・{建築確認申請|けんちくかくにんしんせい} (building permit application)
・Verification of {建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ} (building coverage ratio)
・Verification of {容積率|ようせきりつ} (floor area ratio)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{増築|ぞうちく}{工事|こうじ} (extension work/construction)
・{増築|ぞうちく}{部分|ぶぶん} (extended portion)
・{増築|ぞうちく}{費用|ひよう} (extension costs)
・{増築|ぞうちく}の{許可|きょか} (building extension permit)
